title: The Four Bowls
rumor: The Four Bowls. Broadmaw giants tell of an ancestral feasting ground where four enormous stone bowls stand upon a hilltop. Every generation, wandering giants leave offerings of cattle, fruit, or bones in the bowls. Those who steal from them are said to be pursued by an immense figure that walks only during thunderstorms.
first_lead: Ranchers near the uplands occasionally find enormous footprints leading toward the same distant hill.
